definitions.nativeUnits: The engine uses kg, yards and seconds. Native joint force is kg*yd/s^2, impulse kg*yd/s and work kg*yd^2/s^2. Multiply force/impulse by 0.9144 for N/N*s, and work by 0.9144^2 for J. All saved native fields remain unconverted.
definitions.originalReachPair: Installed kind reach, no live installed combination, and its original target. Every transition is retained; initial ownership is recovered from the first retained update BEFORE snapshot.
definitions.firstHands: First native surviving hand pair after World/cleanup. t is tick-start, completedAt is next native tick boundary; neither is exact continuous first-touch time.
definitions.loaded: That surviving pair has nonzero native tick-mean normal/tangent force. Per-body arm impulse is separately reported and may include other contact in that tick.
definitions.playside: Signed actual blocker-minus-defender center y, using requested run direction. A positive center offset alone is not a winning seal.
definitions.freshRead: zoneReadChanged with zoneRead.t equal controller t; target idx binds to current named target at creation, current reach job, no live combination, solo primary engagement if engaged. Copied seen image must exactly equal a consumed ordinary image.
definitions.inactive: Retained getter values are excluded when current job/target/combo/primary-helper ownership is incompatible; no old phase is counted as a new choice.
definitions.seal: Controller phase only. Actual body position, support, hands and transmitted load determine whether a block succeeds; phase is never counted as achieved success.

limits: One fixed generated roster, two seeds, five fronts and both directions; 40 OZ/WZ and eight installed controls are diagnostics, not NFL rates or outcome calibration.
Initial projection hashes include the new zoneRead field and can change despite identical physical profiles and fixed play inputs.
Only 12 fixed films retain every controller update; panel retains all solo-zone reach updates and transitions. Getter values can outlive eligibility and must be gated.
Fresh image verification uses only consumed sim.see returns. It does not create additional observations or random draws.
Tick-ending surviving hands omit contacts removed in a tick; all per-body delivered impulse/work remains retained.
Available travel is an optimistic free lateral heuristic, not a loaded rollout or physical reachability guarantee.
Collection wall/CPU includes observation, replay recording and a plain rerun. It is not an isolated solver benchmark.
